issue.title: test_palette_tip_marker_write_runs_off_loop fails under the loaded diff-scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Observed 2026-09-25 at master ea25ee2bf plus an unrelated TUI diff in the sase_16 workspace. It failed once in a full diff-scoped 'just test-scoped' run (47440 passed, 6 failed, 33 min wall) and then passed when run alone with '-p no:xdist -p no:randomly'. Fail rate: 1 failure in 1 scoped-lane run; 0 failures in isolation. The failure depends on host load rather than the code under test, so this reproduces only in the parallel lane, not serially. It also failed once in a 4-test batch run while the host was busy, then passed 7 of 7 solo reruns. The test waits on the off-loop marker write with page.wait_for, which times out under load. The test was added by ea25ee2bf (move tip marker write off loop).

payload.entry: CORRECTION: the 'while the host was busy' remark about the 4-test batch is unsupported; the scoped lane had already finished, so load at that moment was not measured. The test failed twice in total (once in the scoped lane, once in a 4-test batch) and passed 7 of 7 solo reruns. The load attribution and the wait_for-timeout mechanism are inferences, not observed; the scoped run's failure output was not retained.
